explainer.title: What is Corporation Tax?
body: Corporation Tax is the tax a UK limited company pays on its taxable profits. Each year the company files a Company Tax Return (CT600) with HMRC, alongside statutory accounts filed with Companies House.
Both filings come from the same year-end figures. We prepare the accounts, calculate the tax, take you through the numbers and file both once you approve them.

explainer.title: What is Self Assessment?
body: Self Assessment is the system HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) uses to collect Income Tax from individuals and businesses whose tax is not fully deducted automatically, such as through PAYE.

If you are required to complete a Self Assessment tax return, you must report your income, certain expenses and other relevant financial information to HMRC so that your tax liability can be calculated.
